blog.wedding-wishes-video.expansion.p.in: Most couples start collecting wishes 1-2 weeks before the wedding. The timeline below is the most common pattern from our 1,500+ wishes-video projects and works well for 100-200 guest weddings.
blog.wedding-wishes-video.expansion.p.wh: Starting at T-14 days gives shy guests time to record in private, plus two natural reminder touchpoints (T-7 and the day-of) without being pushy. Couples who start later (T-3 days or less) typically get 40-60% fewer submissions.
blog.wedding-wishes-video.expansion.li.1: T-14 days: Generate your unique wedding URL, add to your wedding website and IG bio, print 50 QR code cards for the reception tables.
blog.wedding-wishes-video.expansion.li.2: T-7 days: Send a "last chance" WhatsApp to guests who haven't submitted. Expect a 2x spike in submissions.
blog.wedding-wishes-video.expansion.li.3: Wedding day: Run a QR code on a tablet at the entrance. Have a friend gently remind guests during cocktail hour.
blog.wedding-wishes-video.expansion.li.4: T+3 days: AI compiles the messages. Preview in 9 minutes. Download the final video or share via private link.
blog.wedding-wishes-video.expansion.li.5: T+7 days: Share the final video with all guests as a "thank you" with a bonus photo gallery link.
